item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 126 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 126 FINAL #NLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 11:00 AM 26 August 2026

All Rainfall Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides, mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
